decisions.reason: The firm has publicly committed to a Q1/2019 release and invested in a dedicated page, so escalation of commitment makes continued support likely despite the US sales restriction.
This small volume ionization chamber is central to the dosimetry portfolio and has accumulated sunk costs since its 2018 launch, so the firm will persist with it.
As a standard clinical ionization chamber product line with several models, it represents substantial investment and is highly central, making withdrawal unlikely.
